tool.title: Indexing evidence viewer
tool.description: Render the Indexing evidence page: for each indexing method, the held papers it rests on and the skills, Tools and processes that apply it, and the indexing skills with no evidence yet; and its Keywords page (`keywords/`), the derived keywords graph as an A–Z index with the six extraction variants side by side and their agreement with headings, author keywords and the glossaries. Index health is the `lsi-indexes` check of `bun run cat health`.

inputs.name: check
inputs.description: Fail if a page is stale, instead of writing.

inputs.name: site
inputs.description: A site being built: write the pages at their declared route under it instead of under the harness's own site directory. A repository's own site build passes it (the tools layer's `visualiser-writers.ts`), since its harness docs are a pinned mount.

outputs.name: pages
outputs.description: The viewer pages, under the published site directory.

$comment.comment: A viewer generator (`viewerTool` in `../lib.ts` holds the ports every viewer shares).
